name: vaifoou-construction-patterns
description: Inventory of active reusable widgets. Restyle these after brand.ts and atoms; do not fork per page.

atoms.name: Button
atoms.shape: Single button atom with variant + tone props

props.tone: dark (default) | light — only applies when variant=ghost

atoms.notes: primary = filled accent (terracotta), cream type. ghost tone=dark = cream outline on photos/dark. ghost tone=light = dark outline on light sections. link = inline accent text link. Font: Barlow Condensed 14px.

atoms.name: Heading
atoms.shape: All heading levels and the eyebrow label — one component
atoms.notes: Barlow Condensed for h1–h4 and eyebrow. Sizes from brand.ts type{}. color=white renders the warm off-white page color. color=default = near-black heading token.

atoms.name: Text
atoms.shape: All body and UI text — one component
atoms.notes: Work Sans for all body variants. button variant uses Barlow Condensed (display font). color=white renders the warm off-white page color.

atoms.name: IconPoint
atoms.notes: Used inside IconPointBand and IconPointGrid. Tabler icon, h4 title, body description.

atoms.name: ServiceCard
atoms.shape: Card with icon, title, description, and optional link
atoms.notes: Pin CTA with flex-col h-full + mt-auto so links line up regardless of copy length.

atoms.name: InfoCard
atoms.notes: Light or dark variant. Used for 2–4 item info rows.

atoms.name: ReviewCard
atoms.notes: Used inside ReviewsGrid. Stars from the Google Reviews API.

atoms.name: Timeline
atoms.shape: Ordered steps with icon, title, description
atoms.notes: Surface prop: grey | white | dark. Used for process/how-it-works sections.

atoms.name: ProjectBeforeAfterCard
atoms.shape: Before/after image placeholders with project title, description, and linked service tags
atoms.notes: Used on /projects/ for gallery items. Replace placeholders with Sanity images when project content is wired.

patterns.name: Hero
patterns.shape: h1 + paragraphs + optional CTA + optional side image

props.variant: overlay | split | split-dark | words | page | title

patterns.notes: One hero component for the whole site. Do not fork per page. Pass copy and variant from the page file.

patterns.name: Split content + image
patterns.shape: h2 + paragraphs + side image + optional CTA
patterns.notes: Image side comes from Figma. Use for about, service detail, and any text+photo split.

patterns.name: Icon-point band
patterns.shape: 3 or 5 unlinked icon + title + desc, one row

patterns.name: Google reviews grid
patterns.shape: Grid of star-rated review cards pulled from Google/Yelp API

patterns.name: FAQ accordion
patterns.shape: List of Q&A pairs, no cards

patterns.name: Final CTA banner
patterns.shape: Page-ending conversion card — eyebrow + h2 + subtitle + CTA button
patterns.notes: One per page, always last section before Footer.

patterns.name: Site header
patterns.shape: Fixed top nav with logo + links + CTA
patterns.notes: Shared chrome. Do not fork per page.

patterns.name: Sub-service hero
patterns.shape: Dark-overlay photo hero with eyebrow chip, H1, lead body copy, dual CTAs, and trust bar
patterns.notes: Used on all rock-wall and concrete sub-pages. CTAs and trust bar are auto-wired from config.

patterns.name: Service table
patterns.shape: 2-col or 3-col feature/comparison table with eyebrow, heading, optional note

patterns.name: Service cross-links
patterns.shape: Labelled grid of arrow-link tiles pointing to sibling services

patterns.name: Brick-motif CTA banner
patterns.shape: Light-background CTA closer with brick-texture SVG overlay, H2, dual CTAs, trust strip
patterns.notes: Distinct from the dark CTABanner widget. Used on all service pages as the last section.

patterns.name: Service detail section
patterns.shape: Service sub-page detail section with either a numbered process grid or descriptive cards

props.heading: string
props.variant: timeline | cards — timeline renders the numbered process-grid style used on the retaining-walls page
props.animateItems?: boolean — disable card fade-in for sections that should render immediately

patterns.notes: Use for repeated process, materials, structural elements, finishing options, and application sections on service sub-pages.

patterns.name: Site footer
patterns.shape: Footer band with logo, link columns, legal links, copyright
patterns.notes: Shared chrome. Do not fork per page.
